verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Lithic issues virtual and physical cards and applies controls at the program, account, and card level. Nothing in the pack documents which program types it supports, so there is no evidence for debit, prepaid, commercial credit, or consumer credit programs. Virtual versus physical is a card form factor, not a program type, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the platform supports the card types my product needs — debit, prepaid, commercial credit, and consumer credit programs — not just one prepaid rail
